concept_name: CIEU Causal Audit Log for High-Risk AI Agents

what_CIEU_records.X_t: context: who/what acted, when, where, agent/session/action class
what_CIEU_records.Y_star_t: declared intent, expected outcome, normative baseline, constraints
what_CIEU_records.R_t_plus_1: residual/deviation/error/governance gap after comparing outcome against intent

difference_from_ordinary_logs: traces record calls, latency, tool use, and spans
CIEU connects action to expected outcome and observed residual
CIEU supports governance, incident review, and learning
does_not_claim: not energy or critical infrastructure readiness
not EU AI Act compliance proof
not replacement for full technical documentation
not replacement for risk management system
